selection_policy.method: systematic sample with a proportional no-analysis adjustment
selection_policy.base_rule: Select case IDs whose numeric suffix is divisible by three.
selection_policy.adjustment: Replace dr-main-030 with dr-main-028 within the same language and category so two of ten tasks use no_analysis, matching the rounded 5/30 population share.
selection_policy.chronology: Frozen after the v2 main regression run; therefore this subset is descriptive stability evidence, not a preregistered or holdout sample.
